method.scope: Every ID in the committed requirement index and every entry in the committed route/surface registries.
method.allocation: Family-level planning ownership plus individual release-acceptance/use-case track allocation; candidate milestones are not an assertion that every obligation is due at the earliest milestone.
method.ticket_selection: W11-W17 and W31-W38 are selected implementation slices; historical design and source-only work is excluded from that subset.
limits: Ticket references are not completion evidence for every referenced obligation.
Missing ticket reference does not prove missing implementation.
Indexed IDs include goals, risks, historical records, decisions, invariants and references; no completion percentage is calculated.
Source route status is not target-pilot fidelity or full end-to-end proof.
Future planning allocations do not mutate normative release scope or ticket status.
